Dear {vendor} team,

This is formal written notice that {sender} is giving non-renewal notice under {agreement}. We do not wish the agreement to renew when the current term ends on {term_end}.

The agreement states: "{notice_clause}". We are sending this notice in advance of the {deadline} deadline so that it is received in time.

Please confirm in writing that you have received this notice of non-renewal and that the agreement will end on {term_end} without renewal. We would also ask that you let us know if anything further is needed from us to close the account.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
{sender}
